about: A rehearsal of T14-image-editor, written by hand: no model answered these.

value.name: Photo editor
value.summary: Opens a photo from your computer, crops it, adds an arrow and text, and saves it.

code.html:
Photo editor

Open a photo to start.
code.css:
.tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
canvas { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #c8c8c8; border-radius: 0.25rem; }
